title: LED blinky: choose the physical parts
intro: These are the decisions that change the board geometry. The previews are rendered from the real KiCad footprint files.

options.label: Axial THT · 7.62 mm pitch
options.description: Through-hole axial resistor. Easiest to hand-solder and rework.
